commit_message: Integrate ADR0143 resource orchestration with ADR0145 providers
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0143 model resource controls
pr_body:
## Summary

Integrates ADR0143 model-resource orchestration into the current ADR0145 AI Studio without treating external coding agents as ModelBackends. Local Ollama-compatible residency is released before Editor restoration and managed Play, and is reacquired only after authoritative-state re-inspection. Hosted/Enterprise GPU controls remain unavailable. ADR0145 provider selection, provider-managed authentication, MCP injection, canonical-authoring work claims, external process cancellation, diagnostics, and frozen per-run provider snapshots remain intact.

## Validation

Windows Validation: affected. Editor Visual Validation is required on the final exact head.
